description: Standard inline popover — a floating panel anchored to a trigger element. Distinct from the full-screen filter-popup (960×600). Use for contextual actions, quick-info panels, overflow menus.

PopoverTrigger.description: The element that opens the popover on click. Can be any button or ds-icon-btn.

PopoverContent.description: The floating panel. Hidden by default — add .open class to show. Position is calculated from trigger via JS or CSS anchor positioning.

PopoverClose.description: Close button inside the popover content. Optional — popovers can also close on outside click or Escape.

PopoverArrow.description: Optional decorative arrow pointing from popover toward the trigger.

css: .ds-popover-wrap { position:relative; display:inline-flex; } .ds-popover-content { position:absolute; top:calc(100% + 8px); left:0; background:var(--card-bg); border:1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius:8px; padding:12px; min-width:160px; max-width:320px; z-index:150; box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); display:none; } .ds-popover-content.open { display:block; } .ds-popover-content.placement-bottom-end { left:auto; right:0; } .ds-popover-content.placement-top-start { top:auto; bottom:calc(100% + 8px); } .ds-popover-content.placement-top-end { top:auto; bottom:calc(100% + 8px); left:auto; right:0; } .ds-popover-arrow { position:absolute; top:-5px; left:16px; width:10px; height:10px; background:var(--card-bg); border-top:1px solid var(--card-border); border-left:1px solid var(--card-border); transform:rotate(45deg); }

use_cases: Contextual info panel anchored to a table row icon
Quick-edit inline form (single field, save inline)
Tooltip-replacement when content needs interaction (links, buttons inside)
do: Always close on Escape and outside click.
Set aria-expanded on trigger — true when open, false when closed.
Use PopoverClose button when popover contains forms or actions — user needs explicit dismiss.
Keep popover content lightweight — no full forms, no tables inside.
dont: Never use popover for severity/status — must be visible in table column.
Never nest a modal inside a popover.
Never use the 960×600 filter-popup component for a simple contextual popover.
Never leave a popover open when navigating away — always cleanup on route change.
